f.n: Batang Gasan Padang Pariaman Aquatic Park - Core Zone
f.pu: To ensure the restoration of the biota and habitat as well as the protection of biodiversity that is vulnerable to change. It is a a genetic resource protection area with natural and important habitats for fish resources.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Small-scale sailing and fishing; 2. Domestic regular passenger boats; 3. Cruise/tourist passenger ship cruises; 4. Traffic of fishing boats >10GT; 5. Research and education; 6. Fishing; 7. Fish farming; 8. Aquatic nature tourism activities; 9. Provision of aquatic nature tourism infrastructure; 10. f.n: Bunga Laut Strait Aquatic Tourism Park - Core Zones
f.pu: To ensure the protection of coral, marine biota such as turtles, clams and trochus, as well as the development of permitted research and education.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Marine tourism, such as: swimming, diving, snorkeling, fishing, and boat tours; 2. Fishing/harvesting biota; 3. Anchoring; 4. Installation of FADs; 5. Aquaculture.
f.rn: Decree of the Minister of Marine Affairs and Fisheries No. 22/2018, 28 February 2018; Regulations of the Regent of Mentawai No. 46/2015, 23 November 2015

f.n: Pieh Island Aquatic Tourism Park - Bando Is. - Core Zone
f.pu: To protect coral reef ecosystem, sea turtle nesting beaches, and fish spawning grounds from disturbance by humans.
f.re: The following is prohibited: 1. Passing; 2. Catching fish using any tools and materials; 3. Installation of FADs; 4. Anchoring.

f.n: Pieh Island Aquatic Tourism Park - Bando Is. - Utilization Zone
f.pu: To protect a tourist spot for diving, snorkeling, and sea turtle observation.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. The elimination of the function of the area and the extent of the utilization zone; 2. Fishing/harvesting marine resources (fish, coral reefs and other aquatic biota).
